scope: All fixed5349 E0 epochs, independent1m each alternative, costs1/2, original I/E0 exit and terminalOct27. A read-only experiment-one I; only W/T new computation.
feature: Causal adjusted valid C/V closes; origin last already-confirmed E0 up pivot frozen per intent. f_j=positive log increment above prior record high since pivot under original numerical tie rule. Neff=(sum f)^2/sum f^2; >=2 is only this research dispersion boundary, not sustained-trend guarantee.
clock: Origin is observation1; target=origin valid-stock-C/V observation number+4. Count as valid observations arrive, never put future calendar deadline into origin record. Halt/invalid CV does not advance. Source/I/E0 invalidity cancels.

policies.W: If origin Neff>=2 or unknown, original immediate I. If known<2, wait fixed fifth valid observation, no extra dispersion filter.
policies.T: Same targeted wait as W, same origin clock; at fifth observation require frozen-anchor Neff>=2. Then original dayorder, not wait for fresh I at deadline.

continuation: Deadline original non-event eligibility Q_cont AND known G1 ready/warm, original I/E0/source alive; exact current original i_floor for order. Temporary G1 cold while structure alive does not by itself cancel; warmth required at deadline.
unknown: Count absent/NaN origin Neff or pivot and use original I immediately, no added time restriction. Unknown-event outcomes separate and not confirmation support. Known-intent critical anchor/clock cannot become indeterminate; report blocker rather than fabricate cache.
rebuild: An intent ends on rejection/cancel or order submission; after submission original execution-day expiry applies. Only a future new original Q event may start next intent. A rejected deadline cannot reuse its same-close Q. A zero-fill execution day may use that day new close Q because it is later than submitted decision/consumed signal. No rolling extension, old-signal reuse or permanent deletion.
divergence: W/T first common intent has identical clock. After divergence each consumes only own future Q while unheld/no order. Rich-origin exact A identity only before first actual low-intent divergence, not unconditional after state differences.
entry: At most one actual entry per E0 unit, including partial fill as entry. All origin/rebuild/dayexpiry/no-fill and losing units included. F/ACT forced-exit reentries outside this test.
accounting: Compare T-A,W-A,T-W. Derived D copies W entire outcome iff T temporal rule would pass W first actual-entry intent, else cash0 PnL. T-W=(D-W)+(T-D). Later term includes restored/changed path, not pure causal information. No fourth economic arm.
report: Fixed5349 denominator plus first-origin-low subset, ever-low-eligible subset and actual-low-intent subset; unknown separate from no-Q cash. Realized/open/claims, tail either comparison arm>=30% and continuous curve, failures, delayed participation, no-fill, holding duration, raw/repeated signals, standardized first-order/waiting/holding concurrency. Waiting intents reserve no cash.
stop: No parameter change after results, no3/7/extra grade/volume gates, no product/accounts. Fewer fills alone not success. Mixed signs tradeoff; insufficient net/tail value stop this temporal gate.
